messages.content: Summarize: The build failed because the lockfile was stale.
Build failed: stale lockfile. Fix: regenerate the lockfile and rebuild.
Summarize: Tests time out on CI but pass locally; CI runners have 2 CPUs.
CI timeouts: runners have only 2 CPUs. Fix: raise the timeout or shard the tests.
Summarize: Login breaks after the session cookie domain was changed to the apex domain.
Login broken: cookie domain changed to apex. Fix: restore the subdomain cookie or migrate sessions.
